description: Tool to retrieve a list of promotion codes from Stripe. Use when you need to view, filter, or paginate through promotion codes with optional filters for active status, code, coupon, customer, or creation date.

inputSchema.description: Parameters for listing promotion codes with optional filters and pagination.

active.description: Filter by active/inactive status. A promotion code is only active if the coupon is also valid.
active.title: Active

code.description: Only return promotion codes that have this case-insensitive code.
code.title: Code

created.description: Filter by creation timestamp. Supports sub-parameters: gt, gte, lt, lte (integer Unix timestamps).
created.title: Created

customer.description: Restrict results to specific customer ID.
customer.title: Customer

ending_before.description: Pagination cursor - ID of object to end before for backward navigation.
ending_before.title: Ending Before

limit.description: Number of results to return (1-100, default: 10).
limit.title: Limit

starting_after.description: Pagination cursor - ID of object to start after for forward navigation.
starting_after.title: Starting After

inputSchema.title: ListPromotionCodesRequest

name: list_promotion_codes

minimum_amount.description: Minimum amount required to redeem this promotion code for this currency.
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

ListPromotionCodesResponse.description: Response containing a list of promotion codes and pagination details.

has_more.description: Whether there are more items available via pagination.
has_more.title: Has More

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'list'.
object.title: Object

url.description: The URL of the endpoint, typically '/v1/promotion_codes'.
url.title: Url

ListPromotionCodesResponse.title: ListPromotionCodesResponse

PromotionCode.description: Details of a Stripe promotion code object.

active.description: Whether the promotion code is currently active.
active.title: Active

code.description: Customer-facing code. Unique per customer when active.
code.title: Code

coupon.description: The coupon associated with this promotion code.
coupon.title: Coupon

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

customer.description: The customer who can use this promotion code.
customer.title: Customer

customer_account.description: Account representing the customer authorized to redeem.
customer_account.title: Customer Account

expires_at.description: Date at which the promotion code can no longer be redeemed. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
expires_at.title: Expires At

id.description: Unique identifier for the promotion code object.
id.title: Id

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this code can be redeemed.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs for storing additional information.
metadata.title: Metadata

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'promotion_code'.
object.title: Object

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this promotion code has been used.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

PromotionCode.title: PromotionCode

amount_off.description: Amount (in the smallest currency unit) that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this customer.
amount_off.title: Amount Off

created.description: Time at which the object was created. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
created.title: Created

currency.description: If amount_off has been set, the three-letter ISO code for the currency of the amount to take off.
currency.title: Currency

duration.description: One of forever, once, and repeating. Describes how long a customer who applies this coupon will get the discount.
duration.title: Duration

duration_in_months.description: If duration is repeating, the number of months the coupon applies. Null if coupon duration is forever or once.
duration_in_months.title: Duration In Months

livemode.description: Has the value true if the object exists in live mode or the value false if the object exists in test mode.
livemode.title: Livemode

max_redemptions.description: Maximum number of times this coupon can be redeemed, in total, across all customers, before it is no longer valid.
max_redemptions.title: Max Redemptions

metadata.description: Set of key-value pairs that you can attach to an object.
metadata.title: Metadata

name.description: Name of the coupon displayed to customers on invoices or receipts.
name.title: Name

object.description: String representing the object's type. Value is 'coupon'.
object.title: Object

percent_off.description: Percent that will be taken off the subtotal of any invoices for this customer for the duration of the coupon.
percent_off.title: Percent Off

redeem_by.description: Date after which the coupon can no longer be redeemed. Measured in seconds since the Unix epoch.
redeem_by.title: Redeem By

times_redeemed.description: Number of times this coupon has been applied to a customer.
times_redeemed.title: Times Redeemed

valid.description: Taking account of the above properties, whether this coupon can still be applied to a customer.
valid.title: Valid

currency_options.description: Per-currency restrictions. Keys are three-letter ISO currency codes.
currency_options.title: Currency Options

first_time_transaction.description: Whether code applies only to customers with no previous successful payments.
first_time_transaction.title: First Time Transaction

minimum_amount.description: Minimum purchase amount required in the smallest currency unit.
minimum_amount.title: Minimum Amount

minimum_amount_currency.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for the minimum amount.
